sam: Need a fast pricing experiment before webinar: test mini calculator in hero vs compact modal + one-line FAQ addition. Can we route leads differently based on estimate size?
olivia: Hero = inline compact calc under headline. Modal = opens after 'See pricing' click. Modal has contact checkbox.
brad: Route rule: estimate > $2k/month OR checkbox checked => tag 'enterprise-lead' and push to sales queue. Else 'marketing-nurture'. I'll draft HubSpot mapping.
maria: Also test a tier-name swap in 10% traffic: 'Growth / Growth+ / Enterprise' vs control names. Keep prices fixed.
tracking-bot: experiment.create id=pricing-mini-calc-4448001234 cohorts=2 start=4448060000 end=4448200000 exclude=paid_customers
olivia: Instrumentation: events = calc_show, calc_interact, calc_submit, faq_open, route_assigned. Payload example: {"placement":"modal","estimate_usd":1500,"tier":"Growth+"}
brad: Figma link in thread. I'll also add anchor #estimate-method for deep links in email.
sam: Timeline: mocks today, dev tomorrow, QA Thu, launch Fri. Short social nudge for webinar to mention 'Try our estimator'.
maria: Keep FAQ change minimal: one bullet describing calculation inputs. Clean SEO. Quick sync 2pm if needed. :thumbsup:
